opening.argument: The speaker promotes BitConnect lending by explaining that viewers can lend from one hundred to one hundred thousand dollars and receive daily interest, while the displayed BitConnect page presents a volatility-software section and projected-earnings calculator. He also says he invested in BitConnect and directs viewers to join through his referral URL, explaining that signups through the link can earn him a commission. That recruitment benefit ties the investment promotion to his own financial interest. Although he acknowledges significant risk and advises viewers to invest only what they can afford to lose, the records do not verify the advertised returns, the additional percentage, or the referral payments.
